lead: A `Core\Time\TimeOfDay`'s four slots are not readable as properties, and the bottom of each field is a *checker* refusal, not a runtime one.
body: `$t->hour` is `E0405: `Core\Time\TimeOfDay` has no property named `hour``, so a case reads a field back out of `format` (`$t->format("HH") as int`, `format("SSSSSSSSS")` for nanoseconds). `at`'s parameters are `uint`, so `at(-1, 0)` is `E0401` and never reaches the member: only the top bound has a runtime half.
